title: 第474章 哪都有亲戚第473章 犹如天堑般的差距
slug: 九脉被夺我以魔种证无敌
lines: 秦逸脚踩梁成的胸膛，一剑斩下梁成的右臂，强势无比！
这一幕，震惊了在场众人。
同样修为，秦逸却轻轻松松，镇压了来自天庭的人！
“秦逸你大胆！”
跟随梁成而来的南宫易，发出怒喝声。
星空殿的数名逍遥境强者身上，同时爆发出一股强横的力量波动，他们身形一闪，将秦逸围在了中间。
田不归也冲了过来，盯着南宫易，大喝：“上门挑衅的人是你们，怎么，你们都要来杀我师弟了，我师弟反击就是大胆？难不成我师弟得老老实实给你们杀？”
“这世间，没有这样的道理！”
“你们南宫家族若还想要动手，那就试试看！”
说话间，趴在田不归肩膀上的八爷，就仿佛在伸懒腰一样，八条触手抬了起来，一阵扭动。
秦逸盯着脚下的梁成，神色冰冷。
“如果，你还能活着回到天庭，见到了秦云，你记得告诉他，让他每天都要洗干净脖子，因为，我的剑，随时都可能会斩下他的狗头！”
说话间，秦逸的身上，那股魔气与杀意，交织在一起，演化成了一股无比可怕的威势。
紧接着，梁成那掉落在地上的右臂中，所蕴含的气血，便被秦逸吞噬掉，快速干瘪下去，然后化作了齑粉。
梁成的心中，充斥着无穷的恐慌。
秦逸松开了脚，掐住他的脖子，将他举了起来，嗤笑一声，道：“不要再来招惹我，若有下次，我可不会再这么客气了！”
话音落下，秦逸随手一甩，便将梁成丢到了南宫易等人的脚下。
秦逸的声音，陡然拔高。
他倒是想大开杀戒。
但真的不能杀。
一旦杀了梁成，那就是瞬间彻底撕破了脸，局势将会对星空殿非常不利。
所以只能先忍一忍。
南宫易急忙将受伤不轻的梁成抱了起来，低吼道：“天庭使者的怒火，马上就会爆发，你们不会有好果子吃的！”
说完这句话，南宫易赶紧带着人离去。
随着上门挑衅的人，狼狈离去。
周围看热闹的人，也相继散去，一名武盟的老者，走上前来。
老者神色复杂，他看着秦逸，轻叹一声，道：“你们小心点，天庭的人不会咽下这口气的。”
“幸好天庭降临的使者，没有来这里，而是去了别的地方，不然的话，今日就真的没法收场了。”
秦逸目光一闪，拱手：“多谢前辈提醒，前辈您知道天庭使者去了何处吗？”
星空殿的人，毕竟刚到截天岛，掌握的消息有限，武盟的人来的比较早，所以知道的比较多。
武盟老者道：“我们也是来到截天岛后才听说，天庭降临的人，分成了三批，一批去了荒古大陆，一批去捉拿荒主的后人，第三批则是来了截天岛。”
“来截天岛的这一批，实力不算强，连一个逍遥境的都没有，但南宫家族来了一个初圣。”
“天极教，大河剑派，千岛宗，应该都已经跟天庭的人，达成了初步的合作意向。”
content_en:
Qin Yi stepped on Liang Cheng's chest and cut off Liang Cheng's right arm with a sword. It was extremely powerful!
This scene shocked everyone present.
With the same cultivation level, Qin Yi easily suppressed people from heaven!
"Qin Yi, you are brave!"
Nangong Yi, who followed Liang Cheng, roared angrily.
"Boom!"
A tyrannical power wave erupted from several Xiaoyao Realm experts in the Starry Sky Palace at the same time. They flashed and surrounded Qin Yi.
Tian Bugui also rushed over, stared at Nangong Yi, and shouted: "You are the ones who come here to provoke me. Why, you are all here to kill my junior brother. Is my junior brother so bold to fight back? Is it possible that my junior brother has to be killed by you all?"
"There is no such truth in this world!"
"If your Nangong family still wants to take action, then give it a try!"
While he was talking, Ba Ye, who was lying on Tian Bugui's shoulder, seemed to be stretching, and his eight tentacles were lifted up and twisted.
…
Qin Yi stared at Liang Cheng at his feet with a cold expression.
"If you can still return to Heaven alive and see Qin Yun, remember to tell him to wash his neck every day, because my sword may chop off his head at any time!"
As he spoke, the demonic aura and murderous intent on Qin Yi's body intertwined and evolved into an extremely terrifying force.
Immediately afterwards, the energy and blood contained in Liang Cheng's right arm that fell to the ground was swallowed up by Qin Yi, quickly shriveled up, and then turned into powder.
Liang Cheng's heart was filled with endless panic.
Qin Yi let go of his feet, grabbed his neck, lifted him up, sneered, and said: "Don't provoke me again. If there is a next time, I won't be so polite again!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Qin Yi threw Liang Cheng at the feet of Nangong Yi and others with a flick of his hand.
"Get out!"
Qin Yi's voice suddenly rose in pitch.
He wanted to go on a killing spree.
But you really can’t kill.
Once Liang Cheng is killed, his face will be completely broken in an instant, and the situation will be very unfavorable to the Starry Sky Palace.
So I can only endure it for a while.
Nangong Yi hurriedly picked up the seriously injured Liang Cheng and roared: "The anger of the heavenly messenger will explode soon, and you will not get anything good to eat!"
After saying this, Nangong Yi quickly left with the people.
Following the provocative person, he left in embarrassment.
The people watching the excitement dispersed one after another, and an old man from the Martial Alliance stepped forward.
The old man's expression was complicated. He looked at Qin Yi, sighed softly, and said, "Be careful, the people in heaven will not swallow this breath."
"Fortunately, the messenger from heaven did not come here, but went to another place. Otherwise, there would really be no way to end today."
Qin Yi's eyes flashed and he cupped his hands: "Thank you, senior, for reminding me. Senior, do you know where the messenger from heaven has gone?"
After all, the people from the Starry Sky Palace had just arrived at Jie Tian Island and had limited information. The people from the Martial Alliance came earlier, so they knew more.
The old man from Wu Meng said: "We only heard after we came to Jietian Island that the people who came from Heaven were divided into three groups. One group went to the Ancient Continent, one group went to capture the descendants of the Wild Lord, and the third group came to Jietian Island."
"The group that came to Jietian Island is not very strong, not even one from the Xiaoyao Realm, but the Nangong family has a First Saint."
"The Tianji Sect, the Dahe Sword Sect, and the Thousand Islands Sect should all have reached preliminary cooperation intentions with the people of Tianting."
title_en: Chapter 474: There are relatives everywhere Chapter 473: The gap is like a chasm
